Author: FunkyJumbo
Name: DPS In Server Bar
Punchline: Your live DPS, rDPS and party DPS, right in the server info bar.
Description: Shows your real-time DPS, party DPS or FFLogs-style rDPS in the server info bar, with your rank, role comparison, boss HP and projected kill time. Includes a live breakdown window, graphs, pull history with comparisons, party DPS checks and an optional FFLogs percentile estimate. Works with ACT (OverlayPlugin WebSocket) or on its own with the built-in tracker.
Changelog: 1.0.3.0: separator option between bar elements (space, |, /, - or custom); boss HP shown as "HP 54%". 1.0.2.0: ultimate mode (per-phase boss HP, timer and enrage; TEA P1 first), GCD uptime with uptime graph (per phase in ultimates, deaths count). 1.0.1.0: enrage timer in the server bar; set a fight's enrage time from a pull (History > Set as enrage time). 1.0.0.0: full rewrite - built-in tracker (no ACT needed), rDPS, pull history and graphs, party DPS checks with boss HP / enrage, role comparison, FFLogs percentile estimate.
